meta.task: Freight forwarders China (Shandong: Qingdao/Zibo/Zaozhuang) -> Uzbekistan (Karakalpakstan, Kungrad district, st. Kyrkkyz 737105 / Akchalak, Ustyurt GCC), rail via Khorgos/Alashankou-Kazakhstan and/or truck, chemicals in IBC/drums incl. DG class 8/9
meta.method: Company websites fetched directly; independent source = yellowpages.uz directory pages (and goldenpages.uz for Globalink). No contact made with any company. Pages behind bot checks (goldenpages search, railmarket.com) were not accessed.
meta.verified_rule: verified=true only if the same e-mail appears in two independent sources (own site + independent page, or two independent directories). Otherwise verified=false.

sanctions_screening.result: No matches for any listed company. False positives ignored: 'SAADA' only in remarks of Yemen-related individuals (Sa'ada governorate); 'TRANS ASIA INTERNATIONAL HOLDING GROUP THAILAND' is an unrelated Thai entity, not TransAsia Logistics (Tashkent).
excluded: FESCO (Russian; has a China-Tashkent shuttle but is Russia-linked and its own page says DG of all classes are prohibited on that service)
RZDL Transservice / UTI-RZD Logistics JV (Russian state-railway-linked)

important_caveats: No company published an explicit service to Kyrkkyz station (737105) / Akchalak / Ustyurt GCC. AGL and TransAsia list delivery to Nukus (Karakalpakstan); final leg Kungrad must be confirmed in the quote request.

Class 8/9 by rail in containers/wagons China->Kazakhstan->Uzbekistan needs SMGS Annex 2 approvals; several forwarders state DG/ADR/RID capability in general terms, none publishes concrete class 8 rail cases to Uzbekistan.
Only Great Hensen is Qingdao-based; its site confirms Qingdao DG (class 2-9) and rail/Central Asia generally but NOT Uzbekistan specifically.

companies.name: Arrow Green Logistics (AGL) LLC
companies.route_evidence: Own site: China->Uzbekistan delivery articles (auto, rail+auto multimodal, door-to-door incl. Nukus); services rail logistics, multimodal, own terminals (ULS, OLC). DG page: 'all classes', ADR, IATA DGR, IMDG, RID; tanks/containers, rail; MSDS/declarations.

companies.name: Logistic Technology LLC
companies.route_evidence: Own page 'Из Китая в Узбекистан': rail 18-35 days via Dostyk/Altynkol (gauge change), auto 7-20 days via Irkeshtam/Torugart/Khorgos, sea via Qingdao/Lianyungang/Ningbo + rail; rail used for 'chemistry and raw materials'. Service 'Опасные грузы (ADR)': chemicals, paints, batteries with ADR permit.
companies.dg_capability: Stated: ADR road DG incl. chemicals; rail DG 'accepted not always, clarify class in advance'
companies.note: Site lists Iran among export/import destinations (route offering only; no ownership link found). Review against internal Iran policy.

companies.name: Saada Logistics
companies.route_evidence: Own page 'Доставка грузов из Китая': all routes from China - truck via Khorgos, container trains, sea+rail, air; buying/consolidation; rail freight service page.

companies.name: StarWays Logistics LLC
companies.route_evidence: Own site FAQ: China-Uzbekistan 25-30 days; services: rail freight, DG transport, bulk & liquid cargo, multimodal.

companies.name: First Dry Port Terminal (FDP) LLC
companies.route_evidence: Own site: reception/handling of container and wagon cargo from China, Turkey, CIS with customs clearance and storage; forming container trains to China.
